title: $1,000 Cashback on Novated Lease of Tesla Model 3, Jaecoo J5 & BYD Sealion 7 @ Novated Lease Australia
body:
Deal: $1,000 Cashback on Novated Lease of Tesla Model 3, Jaecoo J5 & BYD Sealion 7 @ Novated Lease Australia

[Harrash] how much is your fees and interest rates?
[Aureus] They don't like answering those questions.
[OZB Al] Only $1,000 more than they were before the deal.
[bowtiehoon] Also note if you get fired or redundant you have to pay out the rest of the interest of the contract
[Heybargain] There are options
1. Find another role that offers novated leasing and transfer it over
2. Otherwise if not convert it to a conventional lease (post tax payments)
[bowtiehoon] To my understanding if your were going novated lease you would go electric cause you get 100% of the fringe benefit tax waived whereas not so much with petrol
[freedomofspeech] I always go petrol, they eliminate FBT by having pretax and post-tax portion.
Just go for 55% residual value after 1 year and you make money
[bkksam] Leasing EVs is a very bad investment…your final payment/residual /ballon payment is more likely to be way higher than the 2nd hand market value of the same model.Due to constant heavy factory dicounts on new models.Lack of spare parts and big delays on parts orders.The issue of electric vehicles being harder and more expensive to insure in Australia is tied to the volatile financial risks of falling vehicle prices.Comprehensive EV insurance premiums average around $2,545 per year, which is roughly 40% higher than the $1,702 average for a standard petrol car.For car owners locked into a lease or loan, the premium stays high because it is based on the initial high risk of high-voltage component repairs. Meanwhile, the actual cash value of the car is shrinking, meaning you pay more for a asset that is worth less.
[bowtiehoon] That’s not really fair, depends on ur situation. And they also allow you to choose ur own insurance.
The thing that stopped me was you’re paying a higher interest than a normal car loan. And they tend to be coy about it. While you do end up on top, you have to decide if it’s worth the effort and other risks as I mentioned above
[gccmelb] Reading somewhere, novated leases have increased insurance costs.
